purpose: Convert the EVE structural inconsistency table into an executable diagnostic ontology that maps validated MMABP inconsistencies to EVE pathology preclassification candidates.

dependencies.role: confirms conformance and consistency before diagnosis
enforces platform boundaries and no final diagnosis in Capa 1

D1.authority: MMABP consistency/conformance defines whether a technical inconsistency exists before EVE pathology mapping.

D2.filename: Tabla de Diagnóstico de Inconsistencias Estructurales EVE.docx
D2.path: /mnt/data/Tabla de Diagnóstico de Inconsistencias Estructurales EVE.docx
D2.authority: Defines the diagnostic compartments and maps each MMABP inconsistency to a potential EVE pathology.

D4.authority: Capa 1 evidence/readiness boundary; no final diagnosis, no IR/export from free text.

D5.authority: Runtime normative rules, B7/C20 non-diagnostic boundary, SEM/PST gates, readiness.

compartments.name: PM_MoC_Factual
compartments.diagnostic_question: ¿Los procesos hablan de objetos que no hemos definido, o hemos definido objetos que ningún proceso utiliza?
compartments.pathology_statement: La empresa opera con un lenguaje dual, uno oficial y otro real.

compartments.name: PM_PF_Factual
compartments.diagnostic_question: ¿El proceso real (PF) sigue el camino declarado en el mapa (PM)? ¿Los disparadores y resultados coinciden?
compartments.pathology_statement: La narrativa oficial (PM) es una fachada que oculta una ejecución caótica o extractiva (PF).

compartments.name: MoC_PF_Factual
compartments.diagnostic_question: ¿El proceso (PF) utiliza y manipula los objetos (MoC) de forma coherente con su definición?
compartments.pathology_statement: Los operadores ignoran la definición formal de los datos para cumplir metas locales.

compartments.name: PF_OLC_Factual
compartments.diagnostic_question: ¿El flujo del proceso (PF) respeta las leyes físicas del objeto (OLC)? ¿Intenta forzar estados inválidos?
compartments.pathology_statement: El proceso, para acelerar o cortar esquinas, corrompe la integridad de los objetos de negocio.

compartments.name: OLC_MoC_Factual
compartments.diagnostic_question: ¿El ciclo de vida (OLC) es consistente con la estructura del objeto (MoC)? ¿Todas las operaciones están en el OLC?
compartments.pathology_statement: El ciclo de vida del objeto ignora sus propias capacidades o relaciones estructurales.

compartments.name: PF_OLC_Temporal
compartments.diagnostic_question: ¿La secuencia de estados que impone el proceso (PF) es una secuencia válida y lógica según el ciclo de vida del objeto (OLC)?
compartments.pathology_statement: El proceso fuerza al objeto a pasar por una secuencia de estados ilógica, generando ineficiencias y errores.

compartments.name: PF_OLC_Structural_Alternatives
compartments.diagnostic_question: ¿Las alternativas y decisiones en el proceso (PF) se corresponden con las alternativas causales reales del objeto (OLC)?
compartments.pathology_statement: El proceso ofrece decisiones que son irrelevantes o ignoran las verdaderas bifurcaciones en la vida del objeto.

compartments.name: OLC_MoC_Structural_Iterations
compartments.diagnostic_question: ¿Una relación 1:N en el modelo de conceptos (MoC) se refleja como un ciclo iterativo en el ciclo de vida (OLC)?
compartments.pathology_statement: El sistema no está diseñado para manejar la complejidad de las relaciones múltiples.

compartments.name: PM_MoC_PF_Composite_Factual
compartments.diagnostic_question: ¿El proceso declarado en el mapa (PM), los objetos que dice manipular (MoC) y la forma en que realmente se ejecuta (PF) cuentan la misma historia?
compartments.pathology_statement: Existen estructuras formales completas que en la ejecución real son letra muerta.

compartments.name: PM_PF_OLC_Temporal_Intentional
compartments.diagnostic_question: ¿La intención del proceso (PM), su ejecución paso a paso (PF) y las leyes causales de los objetos que manipula (OLC) son temporalmente coherentes?
compartments.pathology_statement: La empresa declara una intención que el flujo intenta lograr pero que el ciclo de vida del objeto prohíbe en esa secuencia.

compartments.name: PM_MoC_OLC_Structural_Ontological
compartments.diagnostic_question: ¿Los procesos declarados (PM) son coherentes con la ontología (MoC) y con las leyes causales (OLC) de los objetos que dicen gestionar?
compartments.pathology_statement: La empresa cree tener una función que su ontología y causalidad no reconocen.

compartments.name: MoC_PF_OLC_Causal_Operational
compartments.diagnostic_question: ¿La estructura del objeto (MoC), la forma en que el proceso lo manipula (PF) y las leyes de su propia vida (OLC) son mutuamente consistentes?
compartments.pathology_statement: La estructura dice que el objeto puede, la causalidad dice que ahora no, y el proceso fuerza la operación fuera de contexto.

compartments.name: PM_MoC_PF_OLC_Systemic_Total
compartments.diagnostic_question: ¿La totalidad del sistema — su intención (PM), su ontología (MoC), su ejecución (PF) y su causalidad (OLC) — cuenta una historia coherente?
compartments.pathology_statement: Los cuatro modelos revelan fragmentación estructural completa y múltiples arquitecturas contradictorias coexistiendo.

rules.title: D2 is primary pathology map
rules.rule: The chip may map a technical inconsistency to an EVE pathology only when the mapping exists in D2 or in a later approved diagnostic ontology source.

rules.title: D1 validates inconsistency before diagnosis
rules.rule: A pathology candidate must not be emitted until the relevant MMABP inconsistency has been established by conformance/consistency logic governed by D1 and Stage 00.

rules.title: No final diagnosis in Capa 1
rules.rule: The chip emits diagnostic preclassification candidates only; it does not produce final diagnosis, IR, registry, export, monetization or transduction.

rules.title: No cosmetic alignment
rules.rule: If models contradict each other, the chip must require return to factual evidence and must not recommend cosmetic alignment of models.

rules.title: No pathology from text alone
rules.rule: Textual narrative without model evidence, source trace and inconsistency compartment is insufficient for pathology mapping.

rules.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-001 maps to Esquizofrenia Ontológica
rules.rule: When pm_moc_factual_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Esquizofrenia Ontológica for PM ↔ MoC.

rules.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-002 maps to Brecha Intencional
rules.rule: When pm_pf_factual_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Brecha Intencional for PM ↔ PF.

rules.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-003 maps to Anarquía Operacional
rules.rule: When moc_pf_factual_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Anarquía Operacional for MoC ↔ PF.

rules.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-004 maps to Violación Causal
rules.rule: When pf_olc_factual_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Violación Causal for PF ↔ OLC.

rules.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-005 maps to Amnesia Estructural
rules.rule: When olc_moc_factual_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Amnesia Estructural for OLC ↔ MoC.

rules.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-006 maps to Tortura Causal
rules.rule: When pf_olc_temporal_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Tortura Causal for PF ↔ OLC.

rules.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-007 maps to Falsa Elección
rules.rule: When pf_olc_structural_alternatives_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Falsa Elección for PF ↔ OLC.

rules.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-008 maps to Incapacidad de Gestión de Conjuntos
rules.rule: When olc_moc_structural_iteration_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Incapacidad de Gestión de Conjuntos for OLC ↔ MoC.

rules.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-009 maps to Arquitectura Fantasma
rules.rule: When pm_moc_pf_composite_factual_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Arquitectura Fantasma for PM ↔ MoC ↔ PF.

rules.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-010 maps to Promesa Imposible
rules.rule: When pm_pf_olc_temporal_intentional_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Promesa Imposible for PM ↔ PF ↔ OLC.

rules.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-011 maps to Identidad Disociada
rules.rule: When pm_moc_olc_structural_ontological_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Identidad Disociada for PM ↔ MoC ↔ OLC.

rules.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-012 maps to Competencia Causal
rules.rule: When moc_pf_olc_causal_operational_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Competencia Causal for MoC ↔ PF ↔ OLC.

rules.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-013 maps to Incoherencia Sistémica Total
rules.rule: When systemic_total_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Incoherencia Sistémica Total for PM ↔ MoC ↔ PF ↔ OLC.

rules.title: Evidence must identify models
rules.rule: Every diagnostic input must declare the model set involved: PM, MoC, PF, OLC or a cross-model combination.

rules.title: Evidence must identify inconsistency class
rules.rule: Every diagnostic input must declare inconsistency class: factual, temporal, structural alternatives, structural iterations, composite factual, temporal-intentional, structural-ontological, causal-operational or systemic total.

rules.title: Evidence must include source_trace
rules.rule: Every diagnostic candidate must preserve source_trace to the evidence item, model element, gate output or structural candidate that triggered it.

rules.title: Conformance status required
rules.rule: If any involved model lacks conformance status, the candidate must be blocked_by_conformance_unchecked.

rules.title: Consistency status required
rules.rule: If the cross-model inconsistency has not been evaluated by the corresponding consistency compartment, the candidate must be blocked_by_consistency_unchecked.

rules.title: Ambiguity routes to manual review
rules.rule: If evidence is semantically ambiguous, route to manual_review_required instead of forcing a pathology mapping.

rules.title: Single strongest compartment
rules.rule: When multiple compartments fire, preserve all candidates but identify a primary_candidate only if one has higher evidence_strength and broader model coverage.

rules.title: Systemic total requires cascade evidence
rules.rule: Incoherencia Sistémica Total requires contradiction evidence across all four views, not merely two isolated inconsistencies.

rules.title: Temporal PF-OLC distinction
rules.rule: Tortura Causal requires sequence/order violation; Violación Causal requires forcing an invalid state or transition. Do not collapse them.

rules.title: Structural PF-OLC distinction
rules.rule: Falsa Elección requires mismatch between PF alternatives/gateways and OLC causal alternatives. Do not classify every PF/OLC issue as Falsa Elección.

rules.title: MoC-PF-OLC causal operational distinction
rules.rule: Competencia Causal requires the object operation to be structurally allowed by MoC but causally unauthorized by OLC at that state while PF executes it.

rules.title: Aliases are not new pathologies
rules.rule: Aliases such as Esquizofrenia Organizacional must be stored as aliases of an approved pathology label, not as independent ontology entries unless a source explicitly authorizes it.

rules.title: Output type is diagnostic_preclassification_candidate
rules.rule: The only runtime output of this chip is diagnostic_preclassification_candidate or blocked/manual_review state.

rules.title: Output must include method trace
rules.rule: Each output must include method_trace with involved models, inconsistency_type, compartment_id, evidence_refs and source_refs.

rules.title: Output must include pathology trace
rules.rule: Each output must include pathology_trace with pathology label, diagnostic question, pathology statement and source D2 row.

rules.title: Output must include correction boundary
rules.rule: The chip may recommend that the architecture return to factual evidence; it must not directly rewrite models or align them cosmetically.

rules.title: Output must include readiness boundary
rules.rule: Output must expose whether it is ready_for_parallel_production_prep, ready_with_flags, blocked, reentry_required or manual_review_required.

rules.title: B7/C20 non-diagnostic boundary
rules.rule: B7/C20 signals may prepare low-confidence preclassification but must not generate IR, registry, export or final diagnosis.

rules.title: SEM gate before MoC/OLC pathology
rules.rule: If the inconsistency depends on object/state/class/attribute ambiguity, the Semantic Resolution Gate must close before mapping a pathology candidate.

rules.title: PST gate before PF/OLC pathology
rules.rule: If the inconsistency depends on waits, blocking or timers, the Process State/Timer Gate must close before mapping PF/OLC temporal or causal pathology.

rules.title: No exposure of internal diagnosis to UI
rules.rule: The UI may show sober user-facing continuity language; it must not expose pathology labels unless a later explicit diagnostic surface authorizes it.

rules.title: Production Paralela consumes governed candidates only
rules.rule: Downstream consumers must receive governed evidence/candidate payloads, not raw text or unvalidated pathology labels.

rules.title: Manifest must count compartments
rules.rule: Manifest must report exactly 13 diagnostic compartments for v0.1 unless a later approved source changes the ontology.

rules.title: Manifest must count pathologies
rules.rule: Manifest must report 13 canonical pathology mappings for v0.1; aliases do not increase canonical count.

rules.title: No internal GPT instructions compiled
rules.rule: Instrucciones Maestras and Instrucciones Actualizadas are not compiled as platform sources in this chip; they remain assistant-internal context only.

rules.title: No generated rules without source
rules.rule: Every rule must carry at least one source_ref or explicitly mark project_decision for governance decisions made in this conversation.

rules.title: Source checksums recorded
rules.rule: All source documents used by the chip must have existence, size and sha256 recorded in manifest.
